therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in ADAS-Cog11 and ADCS-ADL at 16 weeks after cessation of study drug

results.effect_size: ADAS-Cog11 change: placebo/LY140mg +6.4, LY100mg/LY140mg +12.5, LY140mg/LY140mg +10.5; ADCS-ADL change: placebo/LY140mg -4.5, LY100mg/LY140mg -10.6, LY140mg/LY140mg -5.1
results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma Aβ1-42 percent change at week 12: placebo/LY140mg -5.84%, LY100mg/LY140mg -6.09%, LY140mg/LY140mg +14.27%; semagacestat mean plasma concentration at 2h post-dose 1160 ng/mL
biomarker_changes: Plasma Aβ1-42 percent change at week 12 (LS mean): LFAN Placebo/LY140mg -5.84%, LFAN LY100mg/LY140mg -6.09%, LFAN LY140mg/LY140mg +14.27%
Left hippocampal volume change at week 12 (LS mean mm³): LFAN Placebo/LY140mg -115.39, LFAN LY100mg/LY140mg -279.29, LFAN LY140mg/LY140mg +22.49
Right hippocampal volume change at week 12 (LS mean mm³): LFAN Placebo/LY140mg -141.79, LFAN LY100mg/LY140mg -187.16, LFAN LY140mg/LY140mg -3.86
AV-45-PET amyloid imaging at week 12: analysis not done due to insufficient sample size
Semagacestat geometric mean plasma concentration: pre-dose 1.81 ng/mL, 2h post-dose 1160 ng/mL, 4h post-dose 679 ng/mL, 6h post-dose 341 ng/mL
subgroup_findings: Prior semagacestat 100mg arm showed worse ADAS-Cog11 (+12.5) and ADCS-ADL (-10.6) outcomes vs placebo/LY140mg arm at week 16 post-cessation
Prior semagacestat 140mg arm showed worse ADAS-Cog11 (+10.5) and ADCS-ADL (-5.1) outcomes vs placebo/LY140mg arm at week 16 post-cessation
Left hippocampal volume loss was greater in LY100mg arm (-279.29 mm³) vs placebo arm (-115.39 mm³) at week 12
safety_signals: Serious adverse events reported across all arms including gastrointestinal haemorrhage, ischaemic stroke, syncope, aggression, and skin cancers
Dose reduction to 100mg or 60mg was possible due to intolerability

dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose reduction to 100 mg or 60 mg possible due to intolerability

context.duration: 24 months treatment; assessments at 12 and 16 weeks after cessation
